actionResult.summary: Review 230 Apply: exact-candidate re-verification implementation and immutable 227 history preservation are coherent, but the new user-facing `flowkit verify --retry` write surface is not physically exercised by the selected tests-cli regression set. Reviewer intentionally replaced the --retry route in src/cli/main.ts with the existing read-only verify projection, then ran the exact physical tests-cli selector set; all 33/33 still passed. Formal Change Verification can therefore be green while the newly frozen CLI retry surface is broken.

reviewFindings.title: Selected tests do not physically exercise the new `flowkit verify --retry` CLI write surface
reviewFindings.problem: 228/229 approved Proposal freezes `flowkit verify --retry` as the only explicit re-verification write surface for completed Apply + failed Verification. 230 implements routing in src/cli/main.ts and src/cli/change-action.ts and thoroughly tests the underlying retry service/publication/Reader logic, but no selected CLI/G1 regression invokes `verify --retry`; only bare `flowkit verify` is exercised.
reviewFindings.contractRef: 228 approved Proposal explicit `flowkit verify --retry`; flowkit-change-cli-end-to-end-and-performance explicit retry scenarios; tasks 7.5; Flowkit Explore Skill v2 Verification Closure
reviewFindings.invariant: A changed user-facing CLI behavior must be reached by a physical test selected by formal Verification; logical `tests-cli` selection is insufficient when no executed target invokes the changed route.
evidence: 230 changes src/cli/main.ts so `verify --retry` dispatches to retryChangeVerification(), and src/cli/change-action.ts adds that wrapper.
Selected tests contain G1 coverage for bare `flowkit verify` read-only behavior but no invocation of `verify --retry` or retryChangeVerification in diagnostic CLI/G1/unit CLI tests.
Reviewer changed only the --retry branch in src/cli/main.ts to call read-only projectChangeVerification().
With that broken route, the exact physical tests-cli selector set still passed 33/33, including G1.
Independent retry service/publication/Reader targeted tests passed 112/112, isolating the gap to CLI physical coverage.
reviewFindings.impact: Formal Change Verification can report PASS while the only operator-facing re-verification command required by the approved contract is nonfunctional or silently read-only.
reviewFindings.location: src/cli/main.ts / src/cli/change-action.ts and tests-cli physical regressions
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: Add a regression inside the approved mutation surface that invokes the actual `flowkit verify --retry` CLI path against completed Apply + failed Verification + exact unchanged candidate, proving it publishes the superseding authority/history without allocating a Run. Breaking the route back to bare verify must make selected CLI verification fail.
acceptance: A physical test selected by tests-cli invokes `flowkit verify --retry` through the actual CLI routing surface, not only retryFailedChangeVerification() directly.
It proves retry publishes new authority, preserves predecessor fingerprint-addressed history, and allocates no Formal Action/Run/NNN; bare verify remains read-only.
Routing --retry to bare projectChangeVerification makes the selected CLI regression fail.
Fix remains within the approved 29-selector apply/revise-apply surface or fails closed.
